messages:
Aisha: Heads up — we just got hit with a ~ $14.1k GPU charge from last night that landed on the central billing account. Looks like an internal project was pointed at the prod billing group by mistake. @Tom can you pull labels?
BillingBot: Automated alert: high GPU spend detected (project: internal-eval, delta: $14,112). Ticket created: FIN-9876.
Tom: pulling now. quick query I ran: `SELECT resource.labels, cost, invoice_month FROM billing_export WHERE project_id='internal-eval' AND usage_start_time >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)` — shows `billing_group=prod-central` and `team=unlabeled`.
Priyanka: If it's truly internal eval we should reassign to Search team and do an internal charge transfer. Two paths: 1) ask cloud for a refund/credit (slow), 2) do an internal journal + update showback (fast). Recommend journal + showback for Q1.
Sandeep: What’s the Search team monthly GPU burn? Will this blow their budget? Need to loop in @Search-pmo for approval if we reallocate.
Aisha: Search monthly reserved commit ~ $18k, so this will fit but it tightens runway. I’ll ping Search PMs. Can finance pre-approve a one-off internal transfer so we don’t block running reports?
Tom: fixed the source of truth — misconfigured terraform var in `projects/internal-eval/main.tf` (we had `billing_account = var.prod_billing`). Patch: `billing_account = var.internal_test_billing` and `terraform apply` done. Also added CI check to assert `env != "prod" || billing_account == var.prod_billing`.
Priyanka: Finance ok with journal if we get an e-mail from eng owner + cost breakdown. Aisha please attach the billing export CSV for the 24hr window + the terraform PR link. We’ll log FIN-9876 as journal type: "intercompany cost reallocation".
Aisha: CSV uploaded to FIN Drive: /finance/gpu-transfers/1905554321-internal-eval.csv. PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/4123. @Priyanka can you confirm the GL code we should use?
Priyanka: Use GL 6102 (Cloud compute - internal transfers). I'll set up the journal entry and route to approvals. Approvers: @Sandeep, @Search-pmo.
Sandeep: approve for Search reallocation. Please include note: "one-off misrouted billing due to config error; commit patch applied and CI added".
BillingBot: FIN-9876 updated: status=awaiting_journal_entry. Reminder: vendor credit request still available (contact: cloud-support@vendor.com, MPN 12345) if you want to pursue external refund.
Aisha: Thanks all — I'll close the loop with Search PM and drop the required docs in FIN-9876.
Tom: FYI added a nightly monitor to catch billing_account != expected for non-prod projects. :white_check_mark:
Priyanka: Closing checklist: upload csv, PR link, approver emails, target GL. Once journal posts, finance will reflect corrected team spend in next showback run.
Aisha: Done — FIN-9876 updated with docs and approvers. Leaving thread for record. :thumbsup:
